# External advanced mod (ImGui Direct3D 7)

Implements the Advanced Mod Menu using the Dear ImGui Direct3D 7 renderer (`src/mod_base/imgui_menu_host.cpp`) with the same menu items and native actions as `demos/internal/advanced-mod` (all `simple-mod` items plus):
- Unlimited Ammo
- Music Volume (`Normal`, `Low`, `Mute`)
- Player State
- Refresh Display

Build target: `igi_advanced_mod_menu_external` (`igi-advanced-mod-external.dll`).
